# Care N Cure — Registered Nurse Home Care Perth WA

> Perth's premier registered nurse in-home care practice. Providing dedicated Nurse Coordinators for private nursing, wound care, post-hospital recovery, and aged care support across Perth metropolitan suburbs.

## Core Value Proposition
- **The Nurse Who Knows You**: Every client is assigned one primary AHPRA-registered Nurse Coordinator for continuity, avoiding rotating agency casuals.
- **Fast Dispatch**: In-home clinical assessments arranged within 24 to 48 hours. Urgent post-hospital discharge support available.
- **Full Clinical Scope**: Registered Nurses qualified for complex wound care, catheter management, IV therapy, medication management, and chronic disease support.

## Key Services
- [Private Nursing Perth](https://carencure.com.au/private-nursing): 1-on-1 registered nurse home visits, elderly care, and private nurse hire.
- [Post-Hospital Care](https://carencure.com.au/post-hospital-care): Clinical post-operative recovery, drain management, and discharge transition.
- [Wound Care Services](https://carencure.com.au/wound-care): Sterile dressings, VAC therapy, pressure injury care, and surgical wound management.
- [Medication Management](https://carencure.com.au/medication-management): Subcutaneous injections, IV administration, and dose administration aid setup.
- [NDIS Nursing Care](https://carencure.com.au/ndis-nursing): Community nursing care under NDIS Core and Capacity Building streams.
- [Home Care Packages](https://carencure.com.au/homecare-packages): Subcontracted clinical nursing for HCP Levels 1 through 4.

## Service Locations
Care N Cure services all metropolitan suburbs of Perth, Western Australia, including Nedlands, Subiaco, Cottesloe, Fremantle, South Perth, Applecross, Mount Lawley, Claremont, Joondalup, Midland, Gosnells, Armadale, and Rockingham.
